verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Copilot is built into GitHub.com and answers questions about a codebase. It can also research and explore your repositories, review changes with one-click suggested fixes, and propose Autofix remediations, so users get AI suggestions grounded in their own repo data inside the product. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and evidence of AI insights over non-code data such as issues, projects, or activity analytics.
